sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D044707

nodes.label: Age Distribution
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Age Distribution as: The frequency of different ages or age groups in a given population. The distribution may refer to either how many or what proportion of the group. The population is usually patients with a specific disease but the concept is not restricted to humans and is not restricted to medicine.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017677

nodes.label: Censuses
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Censuses as: Enumerations of populations usually recording identities of all persons in every place of residence with age or date of birth, sex, occupation, national origin, language, marital status, income, relation to head of household, information on the dwelling place, education, literacy, health-related data (e.g., permanent disability), etc. The census or numbering of the people is mentioned several times in the Old Testament. Among the Romans, censuses were intimately connected with the enumeration of troops before and after battle and probably a military necessity. (From Last, A Dictionary of Epidemiology, 3d ed; Garrison, An Introduction to the History of Medicine, 4th ed, p66, p119)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D019352

nodes.label: Family Characteristics
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Family Characteristics as: Size and composition of the family.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005191

nodes.label: Health Status
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Health Status as: The level of health of the individual, group, or population as subjectively assessed by the individual or by more objective measures.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006304

nodes.label: Population Dynamics
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Population Dynamics as: The pattern of any process, or the interrelationship of phenomena, which affects growth or change within a population.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011157

nodes.label: Sex Distribution
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sex Distribution as: The number of males and females in a given population. The distribution may refer to how many men or women or what proportion of either in the group. The population is usually patients with a specific disease but the concept is not restricted to humans and is not restricted to medicine.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017678

nodes.label: Capitalism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Capitalism as: A political and economic system characterized by individual rights, by private or corporate ownership of capital goods, and by prices, production, and the distribution of goods that are determined mainly by competition in a free market. (From Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, 10th ed)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D030861

nodes.label: Economic Development
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Economic Development as: Mobilization of human, financial, capital, physical and or natural resources to generate goods and services.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D057217

nodes.label: Economic Recession
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Economic Recession as: Significant decline in economic activity spread across the economy, lasting more than a few months, normally visible in real gross domestic product, real income, employment, industrial production, and wholesale-retail sales. (National Bureau of Economic Research, Inc, www.nber.org/cycles.html, accessed 4/23/2009)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D057172

nodes.label: Expropriation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Expropriation as: Taking of goods, property, or right of use by GOVERNMENT or others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000070337

nodes.label: Gross Domestic Product
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Gross Domestic Product as: Value of all final goods and services produced in a country in one year.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D059066

nodes.label: Resource Allocation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Resource Allocation as: Societal or individual decisions about the equitable distribution of available resources.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D040841

nodes.label: Universal Design
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Universal Design as: The design of products and environments to be usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaption or specialized design.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000080562

nodes.label: Climate Models
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Climate Models as: Computer representations that simulate or predict the behavior or activity of WEATHER systems, processes, or phenomena.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000090082

nodes.label: Population Forecast
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Population Forecast as: Estimates of projected population.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000069457

nodes.label: Federal Government
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Federal Government as: The level of governmental organization and function at the national or country-wide level.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D035082

nodes.label: Government Agencies
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Government Agencies as: Administrative units of government responsible for policy making and management of governmental activities.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006077

nodes.label: Local Government
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Local Government as: Smallest political subdivisions within a country at which general governmental functions are carried-out.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009111

nodes.label: State Government
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes State Government as: The level of governmental organization and function below that of the national or country-wide government.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013219

nodes.label: Civil Defense
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Civil Defense as: Preventive emergency measures and programs designed to protect the individual or community in times of hostile attack or natural disaster.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002959

nodes.label: Postal Service
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Postal Service as: The functions and activities carried out by the U.S. Postal Service, foreign postal services, and private postal services such as Federal Express.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011177

nodes.label: International Cooperation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes International Cooperation as: The interaction of persons or groups of persons representing various nations in the pursuit of a common goal or interest.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007391

nodes.label: Fiscal Policy
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Fiscal Policy as: Use of government spending and taxation to influence the economy.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000070586

nodes.label: Social Control Policies
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Social Control Policies as: Decisions for determining and guiding present and future objectives from among alternatives.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011049

nodes.label: Apartheid
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Apartheid as: A former political system in SOUTH AFRICA which enforced segregation in all forms, including physical, political, legal and economic discrimination, against all non-white, non-European racial groups.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000072698

nodes.label: Colonialism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Colonialism as: The aggregate of various economic, political, and social policies by which an imperial power maintains or extends its control over other areas or peoples. It includes the practice of or belief in acquiring and retaining colonies. The emphasis is less on its identity as an ideological political system than on its designation in a period of history. (Webster, 3d ed; from Dr. J. Cassedy, NLM History of Medicine Division)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D018595

nodes.label: Communism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Communism as: A totalitarian system of government in which a single authoritarian party controls state-owned means of production with the professed aim of establishing a classless society.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003148

nodes.label: Democracy
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Democracy as: A system of government in which there is free and equal participation by the people in the political decision-making process.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003709

nodes.label: Fascism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Fascism as: Political movement which combines nationalism with demands for political and social renewal. Characteristics include militaristic nationalism, belief in a natural social hierarchy and the rule of elites, and the desire to create a “people’s community”, in which individual interests would be subordinated to the good of the nation. (From www.britannica.com/topic/fascism)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000074440

nodes.label: National Socialism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes National Socialism as: The doctrines and policies of the Nazis or the National Social German Workers party, which ruled Germany under Adolf Hitler from 1933-1945. These doctrines and policies included racist nationalism, expansionism, and state control of the economy. (from Columbia Encyclopedia, 6th ed. and American Heritage College Dictionary, 3d ed.)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D028683

nodes.label: Socialism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Socialism as: A system of government in which means of production and distribution of goods are controlled by the state.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012950

nodes.label: Diplomacy
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Diplomacy as: The art and practice of conducting negotiations between people, nations or other parties such as organizations.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000067551

nodes.label: Environmentalism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Environmentalism as: Advocacy for the preservation, restoration, or improvement of the natural environment. It aims to reduce the impact of human activities on the earth and its inhabitants.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000088724

nodes.label: Lobbying
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Lobbying as: A process whereby representatives of a particular interest group attempt to influence governmental decision makers to accept the policy desires of the lobbying organization.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D008119

nodes.label: Political Activism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Political Activism as: Active involvement in the political process including promoting, impeding or raising awareness of a certain issue or set of issues.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000074439

nodes.label: Politicization
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Politicization as: Generally an issue or an institution emerging into the sphere of politics such as making previously unpolitical matters political. (Tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/13501763.2019.1619188)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000099075

nodes.label: Stakeholder Participation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Stakeholder Participation as: A process between an entity and those groups or individuals potentially or actually impacted by the actions of that entity over a range of activities and approaches.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000073597

nodes.label: Voting
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Voting as: Method by which an individual or a group, such as in a meeting or an electorate, can engage for the purpose of making a collective decision or expressing an opinion.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000096264

nodes.label: Informal Sector
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Informal Sector as: A component of the private sector characterized by ease of entry; reliance on indigenous resources; family ownership; small scale operations; skills acquired outside of the formal sector; and unregulated markets.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000070100

nodes.label: Psychological Well-Being
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Psychological Well-Being as: Condition of existence, or state of awareness, in which psychological needs are satisfied

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000092862

nodes.label: Abortion, Illegal
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Abortion, Illegal as: Illegal termination of pregnancy.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000024

nodes.label: Body Packing
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Body Packing as: Concealing of drugs within the gastrointestinal tract or other body orifice for purposes of DRUG SMUGGLING or to avoid detection by law enforcement. Contraband other than drugs is also sometimes smuggled this way.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000075066

nodes.label: Corpse Dismemberment
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Corpse Dismemberment as: Disjoining the limbs or other parts of a corpse, often in association with criminal acts.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D056146

nodes.label: Defamation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Defamation as: Public false statements that are illegal and damaging to the reputation of a person, group, business, organization, or institution.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000067448

nodes.label: Drug Trafficking
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Drug Trafficking as: The illegal acquisition, sale, production, transport, movement, and distribution of controlled substances such as narcotics.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D064423

nodes.label: Euthanasia, Involuntary
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Euthanasia, Involuntary as: The act or practice of killing or withholding life-sustaining treatment from a person with a medical condition, especially PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES , without INFORMED CONSENT , despite the MENTAL COMPETENCY of the person to give consent.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000078625

nodes.label: Fraud
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Fraud as: Exploitation through misrepresentation of the facts or concealment of the purposes of the exploiter.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005607

nodes.label: Grave Robbing
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Grave Robbing as: Stealing of corpses after burial, especially for medical dissection. In the late 18th and early 19th centuries, in the absence of laws governing the acquisition of dissecting material for the study of anatomy, the needs of anatomy classes were met by surreptitious methods: body-snatching and grave robbing. (Random House Unabridged Dictionary, 2d ed; from Garrison, An Introduction to the History of Medicine, 4th ed, p447; from Castiglioni, A History of Medicine, 2d ed, p676)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D019356

nodes.label: Homicide
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Homicide as: The killing of one person by another.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006708

nodes.label: Medical Neglect
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Medical Neglect as: Failure to seek timely and appropriate care or allow such care for medical, dental or psychological needs by family members, legal guardian and other caregivers. Negligence by professionals is PROFESSIONAL NEGLIGENCE .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000097824

nodes.label: Prescription Drug Diversion
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Prescription Drug Diversion as: The transfer of prescription drugs from legal to illegal distribution and marketing networks.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D064226

nodes.label: Recidivism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Recidivism as: Repeated criminal behavior.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000075665

nodes.label: Sex Offenses
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sex Offenses as: Any violation of established legal or moral codes in respect to sexual behavior.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012742

nodes.label: Theft
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Theft as: Unlawful act of taking property.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013800

nodes.label: Violence
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Violence as: Use of physical force causing or intent to cause harm, injury or abuse.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014754

nodes.label: War Crimes
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes War Crimes as: Criminal acts committed during, or in connection with, war, e.g., maltreatment of prisoners, willful killing of civilians, etc.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014858

nodes.label: Forensic Anthropology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Anthropology as: Scientific study of human skeletal remains with the express purpose of identification. This includes establishing individual identity, trauma analysis, facial reconstruction, photographic superimposition, determination of time interval since death, and crime-scene recovery. Forensic anthropologists do not certify cause of death but provide data to assist in determination of probable cause. This is a branch of the field of physical anthropology and qualified individuals are certified by the American Board of Forensic Anthropology. (From Am J Forensic Med Pathol 1992 Jun;13(2):146)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D018732

nodes.label: Forensic Ballistics
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Ballistics as: The science of studying projectiles in motion, ballistics, being applied to law. Ballistics on firearm projectiles, such as bullets, include the study of what happens inside the weapon, during the flight of the projectile, and when the projectile strikes the target, such as body tissue.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D044709

nodes.label: Forensic Dentistry
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Dentistry as: The application of dental knowledge to questions of law.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005553

nodes.label: Forensic Entomology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Entomology as: The use of insects and related arthropods that inhabit decomposing corpses or remains in the conduct of medico-legal or medico-criminal investigations.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000081230

nodes.label: Forensic Imaging
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Imaging as: The use of various imaging and image enhancement techniques in forensic investigative disciplines. It often includes FORENSIC MEDICINE platforms such as X-RAYS ; CT XRAY; and MRI.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000097785

nodes.label: Forensic Microbiology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Microbiology as: The scientific discipline dedicated to analyzing evidence from BIOTERRORISM , biocrime, HOAX , or inadvertent microorganism/toxin release for attribution purposes.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000095024

nodes.label: Forensic Nursing
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Nursing as: The application of NURSING knowledge to questions of law. It is a specialty of nursing practice involving victims of crime which includes not only attending to the physical and emotional distress of victims, but also the identifying, collecting, and preserving evidence for law enforcement and the criminal justice system.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D053604

nodes.label: Forensic Psychology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Psychology as: A specialty in professional psychology characterized by activities primarily intended to provide professional psychological expertise within the judicial and legal systems.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000077283

nodes.label: Forensic Toxicology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Forensic Toxicology as: The application of TOXICOLOGY knowledge to questions of law.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D053593

nodes.label: Birth Intervals
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Birth Intervals as: The lengths of intervals between births to women in the population.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001721

nodes.label: Birth Order
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Birth Order as: The sequence in which children are born into the family.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001722

nodes.label: Family Structure
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Family Structure as: Structural nature of relationships among members of a household typically in reference to a MINOR residing in the same home. More broadly any organizational framework that determines family membership, and the functions and hierarchical position of family members (https://eric.ed.gov/?qt=Family+Structure&ti=Family+Structure).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000092822

nodes.label: Marital Status
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Marital Status as: A demographic parameter indicating a person's status with respect to marriage, divorce, widowhood, singleness ( SINGLE PERSON ), etc.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017533

nodes.label: Geriatric Assessment
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Geriatric Assessment as: Evaluation of the level of physical, physiological, or mental functioning in the older population group.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015577

nodes.label: Health Inequities
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Health Inequities as: Differences in health status and in the distribution of health resources between different population groups, arising from the social conditions in which people are born, grow, live, work and age (https://www.who.int/news-room/facts-in-pictures/detail/health-inequities-and-their-causes#:~:text=Health%20inequities%20are%20differences%20in,right%20mix%20of%20government%20policies.)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000091682

nodes.label: Nutritional Status
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Nutritional Status as: State of the body in relation to the consumption and utilization of nutrients.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009752

nodes.label: Social Determinants of Health
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Social Determinants of Health as: The circumstances in which people are born, grow up, live, work, and age, as well as the systems put in place to deal with illness. These circumstances are in turn shaped by a wider set of forces: economics, social policies, and politics (http://www.cdc.gov/socialdeterminants/).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D064890

nodes.label: Health Transition
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Health Transition as: Demographic and epidemiologic changes that have occurred in the last five decades in many developing countries and that are characterized by major growth in the number and proportion of middle-aged and elderly persons and in the frequency of the diseases that occur in these age groups. The health transition is the result of efforts to improve maternal and child health via primary care and outreach services and such efforts have been responsible for a decrease in the birth rate; reduced maternal mortality; improved preventive services; reduced infant mortality, and the increased life expectancy that defines the transition. (From Ann Intern Med 1992 Mar 15;116(6):499-504)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D019456

nodes.label: Human Migration
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Human Migration as: Dispersion or dislocation of people from their country of origin, either voluntarily or involuntarily.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D063426

nodes.label: Population Control
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Population Control as: Includes mechanisms or programs which control the numbers of individuals in a population of humans or animals.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011155

nodes.label: Population Growth
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Population Growth as: Increase, over a specific period of time, in the number of individuals living in a country or region.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011158

nodes.label: Sex Ratio
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sex Ratio as: The number of males per 100 females.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012744

nodes.label: Industrial Development
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Industrial Development as: Activity concerned with the planning and building of industries through manufacturing, provision of specialized services, and COMMERCE .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000067896

nodes.label: Developing Countries
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Developing Countries as: Countries in the process of change with economic growth, that is, an increase in production, per capita consumption, and income. The process of economic growth involves better utilization of natural and human resources, which results in a change in the social, political, and economic structures.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003906

nodes.label: Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Infections as: Invasion of the host organism by microorganisms or their toxins or by parasites that can cause pathological conditions or diseases.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007239

nodes.label: Neoplasms
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms as: New abnormal growth of tissue. Malignant neoplasms show a greater degree of anaplasia and have the properties of invasion and metastasis, compared to benign neoplasms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009369

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cardiovascular Diseases as: Pathological conditions involving the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM including the HEART ; the BLOOD VESSELS ; or the PERICARDIUM .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002318

nodes.label: Nervous System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Nervous System Diseases as: Diseases of the central and peripheral nervous system. This includes disorders of the brain, spinal cord, cranial nerves, peripheral nerves, nerve roots, autonomic nervous system, neuromuscular junction, and muscle.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009422

nodes.label: Respiratory Tract Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respiratory Tract Diseases as: Diseases involving the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012140

nodes.label: Digestive System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Digestive System Diseases as: Diseases in any part of the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT or the accessory organs ( LIVER ; BILIARY TRACT ; PANCREAS ).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004066

nodes.label: Musculoskeletal Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Musculoskeletal Diseases as: Diseases of the muscles and their associated ligaments and other connective tissue and of the bones and cartilage viewed collectively.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009140

nodes.label: Endocrine System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Endocrine System Diseases as: Pathological processes of the ENDOCRINE GLANDS , and diseases resulting from abnormal level of available HORMONES .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004700

nodes.label: Immune System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Immune System Diseases as: Disorders caused by abnormal or absent immunologic mechanisms, whether humoral, cell-mediated, or both.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007154

nodes.label: Mental Disorders
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Mental Disorders as: Psychiatric illness or diseases manifested by breakdowns in the adaptational process expressed primarily as abnormalities of thought, feeling, and behavior producing either distress or impairment of function.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001523

nodes.label: Wounds and Injuries
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Wounds and Injuries as: Damage inflicted on the body as the direct or indirect result of an external force, with or without disruption of structural continuity.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014947

nodes.label: Hemic and Lymphatic Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Hemic and Lymphatic Diseases as: Hematologic diseases and diseases of the lymphatic system collectively. Hemic diseases include disorders involving the formed elements (e.g., ERYTHROCYTE AGGREGATION, INTRAVASCULAR ) and chemical components (e.g., BLOOD PROTEIN DISORDERS ); lymphatic diseases include disorders relating to lymph, lymph nodes, and lymphocytes.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006425

nodes.label: Aneurysm, Infected
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Aneurysm, Infected as: Aneurysm due to growth of microorganisms in the arterial wall, or infection arising within preexisting arteriosclerotic aneurysms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000785

nodes.label: Arthritis, Infectious
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Arthritis, Infectious as: Arthritis caused by BACTERIA ; RICKETTSIA ; MYCOPLASMA ; VIRUSES ; FUNGI ; or PARASITES .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001170

nodes.label: Asymptomatic Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Asymptomatic Infections as: Infections that do not exhibit symptoms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D058345

nodes.label: Bacterial Infections and Mycoses
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Bacterial Infections and Mycoses as: Infections caused by bacteria and fungi, general, specified, or unspecified.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001423

nodes.label: Bone Diseases, Infectious
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Bone Diseases, Infectious as: Bone diseases caused by pathogenic microorganisms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001850

nodes.label: Breakthrough Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Breakthrough Infections as: Infections by the same infectious agent (e.g., virus, fungus) occurring during exposure to prophylaxis, vaccine and treatment.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000093742

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cardiovascular Infections as: Pathological conditions of the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM caused by infections.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D053821

nodes.label: Catheter-Related Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Catheter-Related Infections as: Infections resulting from the use of catheters. Proper aseptic technique, site of catheter placement, material composition, and virulence of the organism are all factors that can influence possible infection.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D055499

nodes.label: Central Nervous System Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Central Nervous System Infections as: Pathogenic infections of the brain, spinal cord, and meninges. DNA VIRUS INFECTIONS ; RNA VIRUS INFECTIONS ; BACTERIAL INFECTIONS ; MYCOPLASMA INFECTIONS ; SPIROCHAETALES INFECTIONS ; fungal infections; PROTOZOAN INFECTIONS ; HELMINTHIASIS ; and PRION DISEASES may involve the central nervous system as a primary or secondary process.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002494

nodes.label: Coinfection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Coinfection as: Simultaneous infection of a host organism by two or more pathogens. In virology, coinfection commonly refers to simultaneous infection of a single cell by two or more different viruses.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D060085

nodes.label: Communicable Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Communicable Diseases as: An illness caused by an infectious agent or its toxins that occurs through the direct or indirect transmission of the infectious agent or its products from an infected individual or via an animal, vector or the inanimate environment to a susceptible animal or human host.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003141

nodes.label: Community-Acquired Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Community-Acquired Infections as: Any infection acquired in the community, that is, contrasted with those acquired in a health care facility ( CROSS INFECTION ). An infection would be classified as community-acquired if the patient had not recently been in a health care facility or been in contact with someone who had been recently in a health care facility.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017714

nodes.label: Cross Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cross Infection as: Any infection which a patient contracts in a health-care institution.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003428

nodes.label: Eye Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Eye Infections as: Infection, moderate to severe, caused by bacteria, fungi, or viruses, which occurs either on the external surface of the eye or intraocularly with probable inflammation, visual impairment, or blindness.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015817

nodes.label: Focal Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Focal Infection as: An infection at a specific location that may spread to another region of the body.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005490

nodes.label: Gingivitis
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Gingivitis as: Inflammation of gum tissue ( GINGIVA ) without loss of connective tissue.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005891

nodes.label: Hepatitis, Animal
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Hepatitis, Animal as: INFLAMMATION of the LIVER in non-human animals.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006520

nodes.label: Intraabdominal Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Intraabdominal Infections as: Infection within the PERITONEAL CAVITY. A frequent cause is an ANASTOMOTIC LEAK following surgery.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D059413

nodes.label: Laboratory Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Laboratory Infection as: Accidentally acquired infection in laboratory workers.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007757

nodes.label: Latent Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Latent Infection as: Delayed infection of the host by a dormant or inactive pathogen.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000085343

nodes.label: Opportunistic Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Opportunistic Infections as: An infection caused by an organism which becomes pathogenic under certain conditions, e.g., during immunosuppression.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009894

nodes.label: Parasitic Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Parasitic Diseases as: Infections or infestations with PARASITES . They are often contracted through contact with an intermediate vector, but may occur as the result of direct exposure.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010272

nodes.label: Pelvic Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pelvic Infection as: Infection involving the tissues or organs in the PELVIS .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D034161

nodes.label: Persistent Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Persistent Infection as: Infection which lasts for a long period with continuous display of clinical features. Persistent infection arises due to inability of host cells to clear primary infections completely. When persistent infections are cleared so that infection symptoms are under control they are often referred to as chronic infections. LATENT INFECTIONS are infections in which manifestation of clinical symptoms appear later.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000088562

nodes.label: Poult Enteritis Mortality Syndrome
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Poult Enteritis Mortality Syndrome as: An acute, transmissible, infectious disease associated with high MORTALITY and MORBIDITY in young turkeys (poults). It is characterized by DIARRHEA ; ANOREXIA ; growth depression, and immune dysfunction. The cause is unknown but astroviruses ( AVASTROVIRUS ) and coronaviruses ( CORONAVIRUS, TURKEY ) have been isolated from diseased poults and are thought to cause the enteritis and increased susceptibility to bacterial infections.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D031261

nodes.label: Pregnancy Complications, Infectious
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pregnancy Complications, Infectious as: The co-occurrence of pregnancy and an INFECTION . The infection may precede or follow FERTILIZATION .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011251

nodes.label: Prosthesis-Related Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Prosthesis-Related Infections as: Infections resulting from the implantation of prosthetic devices. The infections may be acquired from intraoperative contamination (early) or hematogenously acquired from other sites (late).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D016459

nodes.label: Reproductive Tract Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Reproductive Tract Infections as: Infections of the genital tract in females or males. They can be caused by endogenous, iatrogenic, or sexually transmitted organisms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D060737

nodes.label: Respiratory Tract Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respiratory Tract Infections as: Invasion of the host RESPIRATORY SYSTEM by microorganisms, usually leading to pathological processes or diseases.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012141

nodes.label: Sepsis
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sepsis as: Systemic inflammatory response syndrome with a proven or suspected infectious etiology. When sepsis is associated with organ dysfunction distant from the site of infection, it is called severe sepsis. When sepsis is accompanied by HYPOTENSION despite adequate fluid infusion, it is called SEPTIC SHOCK .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D018805

nodes.label: Sexually Transmitted Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sexually Transmitted Diseases as: Diseases due to or propagated by sexual contact.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012749

nodes.label: Skin Diseases, Infectious
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Skin Diseases, Infectious as: Skin diseases caused by bacteria, fungi, parasites, or viruses.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012874

nodes.label: Soft Tissue Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Soft Tissue Infections as: Infections of non-skeletal tissue, i.e., exclusive of bone, ligaments, cartilage, and fibrous tissue. The concept is usually referred to as skin and soft tissue infections and usually subcutaneous and muscle tissue are involved. The predisposing factors in anaerobic infections are trauma, ischemia, and surgery. The organisms often derive from the fecal or oral flora, particularly in wounds associated with intestinal surgery, decubitus ulcer, and human bites. (From Cecil Textbook of Medicine, 19th ed, p1688)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D018461

nodes.label: Suppuration
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Suppuration as: A pathologic process consisting in the formation of pus.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013492

nodes.label: Toxemia
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Toxemia as: A condition produced by the presence of toxins or other harmful substances in the BLOOD .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014115

nodes.label: Urinary Tract Infections
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Urinary Tract Infections as: Inflammatory responses of the epithelium of the URINARY TRACT to microbial invasions. They are often bacterial infections with associated BACTERIURIA and PYURIA .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014552

nodes.label: Vaccine-Preventable Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Vaccine-Preventable Diseases as: Diseases for which vaccines exist that can confer partial or complete protection. (World Health Organization vaccine-safety-training.org)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000079263

nodes.label: Vector Borne Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Vector Borne Diseases as: Infectious diseases transmitted by DISEASE VECTORS .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000079426

nodes.label: Virus Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Virus Diseases as: A general term for diseases caused by viruses.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014777

nodes.label: Waterborne Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Waterborne Diseases as: Illnesses due to micro-organisms and chemicals in drinking water, those caused by organisms having part of their lifecycle in water or those with water-related vectors, and others spread by aerosols containing pathogens.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000069578

nodes.label: Wound Infection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Wound Infection as: Invasion of a wound by pathogenic microorganisms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014946

nodes.label: Zoonoses
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Zoonoses as: Diseases of non-human animals that may be transmitted to HUMANS or may be transmitted from humans to non-human animals.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015047

nodes.label: Cysts
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cysts as: Any fluid-filled closed cavity or sac that is lined by an EPITHELIUM . Cysts can be of normal, abnormal, non-neoplastic, or neoplastic tissues.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003560

nodes.label: Hamartoma
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Hamartoma as: A focal malformation resembling a neoplasm, composed of an overgrowth of mature cells and tissues that normally occur in the affected area.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006222

nodes.label: Neoplasms by Histologic Type
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms by Histologic Type as: A collective term for the various histological types of NEOPLASMS . It is more likely to be used by searchers than by indexers and catalogers.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009370

nodes.label: Neoplasms by Site
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms by Site as: A collective term for precoordinated organ/neoplasm headings locating neoplasms by organ, as BRAIN NEOPLASMS ; DUODENAL NEOPLASMS ; LIVER NEOPLASMS ; etc.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009371

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Experimental
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Experimental as: Experimentally induced new abnormal growth of TISSUES in animals to provide models for studying human neoplasms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009374

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Hormone-Dependent
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Hormone-Dependent as: Certain tumors that 1, arise in organs that are normally dependent on specific hormones and 2, are stimulated or caused to regress by manipulation of the endocrine environment.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009376

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Multiple Primary
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Multiple Primary as: Two or more abnormal growths of tissue occurring simultaneously and presumed to be of separate origin. The neoplasms may be histologically the same or different, and may be found in the same or different sites.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009378

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Post-Traumatic
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Post-Traumatic as: Tumors, cancer or other neoplasms caused by or resulting from trauma or other non-radiation injuries.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017169

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Radiation-Induced
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Radiation-Induced as: Tumors, cancer or other neoplasms produced by exposure to ionizing or non-ionizing radiation.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009381

nodes.label: Neoplasms, Second Primary
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplasms, Second Primary as: Abnormal growths of tissue that follow a previous neoplasm but are not metastases of the latter. The second neoplasm may have the same or different histological type and can occur in the same or different organs as the previous neoplasm but in all cases arises from an independent oncogenic event. The development of the second neoplasm may or may not be related to the treatment for the previous neoplasm since genetic risk or predisposing factors may actually be the cause.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D016609

nodes.label: Neoplastic Processes
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplastic Processes as: The pathological mechanisms and forms taken by tissue during degeneration into a neoplasm and its subsequent activity.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009385

nodes.label: Neoplastic Syndromes, Hereditary
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neoplastic Syndromes, Hereditary as: The condition of a pattern of malignancies within a family, but not every individual's necessarily having the same neoplasm. Characteristically the tumor tends to occur at an earlier than average age, individuals may have more than one primary tumor, the tumors may be multicentric, usually more than 25 percent of the individuals in direct lineal descent from the proband are affected, and the cancer predisposition in these families behaves as an autosomal dominant trait with about 60 percent penetrance.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009386

nodes.label: Paraneoplastic Syndromes
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Paraneoplastic Syndromes as: In patients with neoplastic diseases a wide variety of clinical pictures which are indirect and usually remote effects produced by tumor cell metabolites or other products.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010257

nodes.label: Precancerous Conditions
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Precancerous Conditions as: Pathological conditions that tend eventually to become malignant.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011230

nodes.label: Pregnancy Complications, Neoplastic
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pregnancy Complications, Neoplastic as: The co-occurrence of pregnancy and NEOPLASMS . The neoplastic disease may precede or follow FERTILIZATION .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011252

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Abnormalities
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cardiovascular Abnormalities as: Congenital, inherited, or acquired anomalies of the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM , including the HEART and BLOOD VESSELS .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D018376

nodes.label: Heart Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Heart Diseases as: Pathological conditions involving the HEART including its structural and functional abnormalities.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006331

nodes.label: Pregnancy Complications, Cardiovascular
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pregnancy Complications, Cardiovascular as: The co-occurrence of pregnancy and a cardiovascular disease. The disease may precede or follow FERTILIZATION and it may or may not have a deleterious effect on the pregnant woman or FETUS .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011249

nodes.label: Vascular Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Vascular Diseases as: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES ; VEINS ; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014652

nodes.label: Autoimmune Diseases of the Nervous System
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Autoimmune Diseases of the Nervous System as: Disorders caused by cellular or humoral immune responses primarily directed towards nervous system autoantigens. The immune response may be directed towards specific tissue components (e.g., myelin) and may be limited to the central nervous system (e.g., MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS ) or the peripheral nervous system (e.g., GUILLAIN-BARRE SYNDROME ).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D020274

nodes.label: Autonomic Nervous System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Autonomic Nervous System Diseases as: Diseases of the AUTONOMIC NERVOUS SYSTEM , including sympathetic, parasympathetic, and enteric nervous systems.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001342

nodes.label: Central Nervous System Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Central Nervous System Diseases as: Diseases of any component of the brain (including the cerebral hemispheres, diencephalon, brain stem, and cerebellum) or the spinal cord.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002493

nodes.label: Chronobiology Disorders
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Chronobiology Disorders as: Disruptions of the rhythmic cycle of bodily functions or activities.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D021081

nodes.label: Cranial Nerve Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Cranial Nerve Diseases as: Disorders of one or more of the twelve cranial nerves. With the exception of the optic and olfactory nerves, this includes disorders of the brain stem nuclei from which the cranial nerves originate or terminate.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003389

nodes.label: Demyelinating Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Demyelinating Diseases as: Diseases characterized by loss or dysfunction of myelin in the central or peripheral nervous system.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003711

nodes.label: Nervous System Malformations
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Nervous System Malformations as: Structural abnormalities of the central or peripheral nervous system resulting primarily from defects of embryogenesis.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009421

nodes.label: Nervous System Neoplasms
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Nervous System Neoplasms as: Benign and malignant neoplastic processes arising from or involving components of the central, peripheral, and autonomic nervous systems, cranial nerves, and meninges. Included in this category are primary and metastatic nervous system neoplasms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009423

nodes.label: Neurocutaneous Syndromes
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neurocutaneous Syndromes as: A group of disorders characterized by ectodermal-based malformations and neoplastic growths in the skin, nervous system, and other organs.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D020752

nodes.label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neurodegenerative Diseases as: Hereditary and sporadic conditions which are characterized by progressive nervous system dysfunction. These disorders are often associated with atrophy of the affected central or peripheral nervous system structures.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D019636

nodes.label: Neuroinflammatory Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neuroinflammatory Diseases as: Diseases characterized by inflammation of the nervous tissue.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000090862

nodes.label: Neurologic Manifestations
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neurologic Manifestations as: Clinical signs and symptoms caused by nervous system injury or dysfunction.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009461

nodes.label: Neuromuscular Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neuromuscular Diseases as: A general term encompassing lower MOTOR NEURON DISEASE ; PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM DISEASES ; and certain MUSCULAR DISEASES . Manifestations include MUSCLE WEAKNESS ; FASCICULATION ; muscle ATROPHY ; SPASM ; MYOKYMIA ; MUSCLE HYPERTONIA , myalgias, and MUSCLE HYPOTONIA .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009468

nodes.label: Neurotoxicity Syndromes
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neurotoxicity Syndromes as: Neurologic disorders caused by exposure to toxic substances through ingestion, injection, cutaneous application, or other method. This includes conditions caused by biologic, chemical, and pharmaceutical agents.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D020258

nodes.label: Restless Legs Syndrome
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Restless Legs Syndrome as: A disorder characterized by aching or burning sensations in the lower and rarely the upper extremities that occur prior to sleep or may awaken the patient from sleep.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012148

nodes.label: Sleep Wake Disorders
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sleep Wake Disorders as: Abnormal sleep-wake schedule or pattern associated with the CIRCADIAN RHYTHM which affect the length, timing, and/or rigidity of the sleep-wake cycle relative to the day-night cycle.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012893

nodes.label: Trauma, Nervous System
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Trauma, Nervous System as: Traumatic injuries to the brain, cranial nerves, spinal cord, autonomic nervous system, or neuromuscular system, including iatrogenic injuries induced by surgical procedures.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D020196

nodes.label: Bronchial Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Bronchial Diseases as: Diseases involving the BRONCHI .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001982

nodes.label: Ciliary Motility Disorders
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Ciliary Motility Disorders as: Conditions caused by abnormal CILIA movement in the body, usually causing KARTAGENER SYNDROME , chronic respiratory disorders, chronic SINUSITIS , and chronic OTITIS . Abnormal ciliary beating is likely due to defects in any of the 200 plus ciliary proteins, such as missing motor enzyme DYNEIN arms.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002925

nodes.label: Granuloma, Respiratory Tract
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Granuloma, Respiratory Tract as: Granulomatous disorders affecting one or more sites in the respiratory tract.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015769

nodes.label: Laryngeal Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Laryngeal Diseases as: Pathological processes involving any part of the LARYNX which coordinates many functions such as voice production, breathing, swallowing, and coughing.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007818

nodes.label: Lung Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Lung Diseases as: Pathological processes involving any part of the LUNG .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D008171

nodes.label: Nose Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Nose Diseases as: Disorders of the nose, general or unspecified.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009668

nodes.label: Pleural Diseases
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pleural Diseases as: Diseases involving the PLEURA .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010995

nodes.label: Respiration Disorders
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respiration Disorders as: Diseases of the respiratory system in general or unspecified or for a specific respiratory disease not available.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012120

nodes.label: Respiratory Hypersensitivity
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respiratory Hypersensitivity as: A form of hypersensitivity affecting the respiratory tract. It includes ASTHMA and RHINITIS, ALLERGIC, SEASONAL .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012130

nodes.label: Respiratory System Abnormalities
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respiratory System Abnormalities as: Congenital structural abnormalities of the respiratory system.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015619

nodes.label: Behavior and Behavior Mechanisms
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Behavior and Behavior Mechanisms as: The observable response made to a situation and the unconscious processes underlying it.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001520

nodes.label: Adaptation, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Adaptation, Psychological as: A state of harmony between internal needs and external demands and the processes used in achieving this condition. (From APA Thesaurus of Psychological Index Terms, 8th ed).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000223

nodes.label: Attitude
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Attitude as: An enduring, learned predisposition to behave in a consistent way toward a given class of objects, or a persistent mental and/or neural state of readiness to react to a certain class of objects, not as they are but as they are conceived to be.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001290

nodes.label: Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Behavior as: The observable response of a man or animal to a situation.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001519

nodes.label: Child Rearing
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Child Rearing as: The training or bringing-up of children by parents or parent-substitutes. It is used also for child rearing practices in different societies, at different economic levels, in different ethnic groups, etc. It differs from PARENTING in that in child rearing the emphasis is on the act of training or bringing up the child and the interaction between the parent and child, while parenting emphasizes the responsibility and qualities of exemplary behavior of the parent.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002668

nodes.label: Defense Mechanisms
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Defense Mechanisms as: Unconscious process used by an individual or a group of individuals in order to cope with impulses, feelings or ideas which are not acceptable at their conscious level; various types include reaction formation, projection and self reversal.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003674

nodes.label: Emotions
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Emotions as: Those affective states which can be experienced and have arousing and motivational properties.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004644

nodes.label: Outcome Expectations
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Outcome Expectations as: Believed or anticipated consequences of a person’s behavior.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000099056

nodes.label: Human Characteristics
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Human Characteristics as: The fundamental dispositions and traits of humans. (Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, 10th ed)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D040821

nodes.label: Human Development
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Human Development as: Continuous sequential changes which occur in the physiological and psychological functions during the life-time of an individual.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006803

nodes.label: Mental Competency
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Mental Competency as: The ability to understand the nature and effect of the act in which the individual is engaged. (From Black's Law Dictionary, 6th ed).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D016743

nodes.label: Motivation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Motivation as: Those factors which cause an organism to behave or act in either a goal-seeking or satisfying manner. They may be influenced by physiological drives or by external stimuli.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009042

nodes.label: Neurobehavioral Manifestations
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Neurobehavioral Manifestations as: Signs and symptoms of higher cortical dysfunction caused by organic conditions. These include certain behavioral alterations and impairments of skills involved in the acquisition, processing, and utilization of knowledge or information.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D019954

nodes.label: Personality
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Personality as: Behavior-response patterns that characterize the individual.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010551

nodes.label: Psychology, Social
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Psychology, Social as: The branch of psychology concerned with the effects of group membership upon the behavior, attitudes, and beliefs of an individual.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011593

nodes.label: Psychosocial Functioning
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Psychosocial Functioning as: Level of and variations in social and emotional activity or behaviors.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000083623

nodes.label: Temperance
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Temperance as: Habitual moderation in the indulgence of a natural appetite, especially but not exclusively the consumption of alcohol.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013695

nodes.label: Coping Skills
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Coping Skills as: Various techniques for actively managing a stressful event or situation.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000097813

nodes.label: Emotional Adjustment
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Emotional Adjustment as: Psychological process that occurs when an individual adapts to a significant emotional event or stimulus.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000066498

nodes.label: Feedback, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Feedback, Psychological as: A mechanism of information stimulus and response that may control subsequent behavior, cognition, perception, or performance. (From APA Thesaurus of Psychological Index Terms, 8th ed.)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D030141

nodes.label: Orientation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Orientation as: Awareness of oneself in relation to time, place and person.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009949

nodes.label: Posttraumatic Growth, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Posttraumatic Growth, Psychological as: Positive change experienced as a result of the struggle with a major life crisis or a traumatic event.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000078002

nodes.label: Psychological Growth
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Psychological Growth as: A process of actively learning and adapting to new ways to function following a challenging life crisis.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000097812

nodes.label: Sense of Coherence
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sense of Coherence as: A view of the world and the individual's environment as comprehensible, manageable, and meaningful, claiming that the way people view their life has a positive influence on their health.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D060685

nodes.label: Attitude of Health Personnel
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Attitude of Health Personnel as: Attitudes of personnel toward their patients, other professionals, toward the medical care system, etc.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001291

nodes.label: Attitude to Computers
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Attitude to Computers as: The attitude and behavior associated with an individual using the computer.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001292

nodes.label: Attitude to Death
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Attitude to Death as: Conceptual response of the person to the various aspects of death, which are based on individual psychosocial and cultural experience.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001293

nodes.label: Attitude to Health
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Attitude to Health as: Public attitudes toward health, disease, and the medical care system.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001294

nodes.label: Catastrophization
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Catastrophization as: Cognitive and emotional processes encompassing magnification of pain-related stimuli, feelings of helplessness, and a generally pessimistic orientation.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D058443

nodes.label: Optimism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Optimism as: Mental attitude that interprets life events as generally being positive.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000067656

nodes.label: Pessimism
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Pessimism as: Mental attitude that interprets life events as generally being negative.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000067657

nodes.label: Respect
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Respect as: A feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements and regard for the feelings, wishes, or rights of others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000078682

nodes.label: Stereotyping
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Stereotyping as: An oversimplified perception or conception especially of persons, social groups, etc.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013240

nodes.label: Accident Proneness
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Accident Proneness as: Tendency toward involvement in accidents. Implies certain personality characteristics which predispose to accidents.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000057

nodes.label: Adolescent Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Adolescent Behavior as: Any observable response or action of an adolescent.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000294

nodes.label: Behavior, Animal
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Behavior, Animal as: The observable response an animal makes to any situation.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001522

nodes.label: Behavioral Symptoms
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Behavioral Symptoms as: Observable manifestations of impaired psychological functioning.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D001526

nodes.label: Child Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Child Behavior as: Any observable response or action of a child from 24 months through 12 years of age. For neonates or children younger than 24 months, INFANT BEHAVIOR is available.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D002652

nodes.label: Codependency, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Codependency, Psychological as: A relational pattern in which a person attempts to derive a sense of purpose through relationships with others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D017004

nodes.label: Communication
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Communication as: The exchange or transmission of ideas, attitudes, or beliefs between individuals or groups.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003142

nodes.label: Consumer Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Consumer Behavior as: Behavior associated with the procurement of goods, services, or experiences.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003258

nodes.label: Criminal Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Criminal Behavior as: Conduct leading to commission of unlawful acts.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000066479

nodes.label: Dangerous Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Dangerous Behavior as: Actions which have a high risk of being harmful or injurious to oneself or others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003617

nodes.label: Drinking Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Drinking Behavior as: Behaviors associated with the ingesting of water and other liquids; includes rhythmic patterns of drinking (time intervals - onset and duration), frequency and satiety.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004327

nodes.label: Drug-Seeking Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Drug-Seeking Behavior as: Activities performed to obtain licit or illicit substances.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D058999

nodes.label: Escape Reaction
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Escape Reaction as: Innate response elicited by sensory stimuli associated with a threatening situation, or actual confrontation with an enemy.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004924

nodes.label: Exploratory Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Exploratory Behavior as: The tendency to explore or investigate a novel environment. It is considered a motivation not clearly distinguishable from curiosity.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005106

nodes.label: Feeding Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Feeding Behavior as: Behavioral responses or sequences associated with eating including modes of feeding, rhythmic patterns of eating, and time intervals.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005247

nodes.label: Habits
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Habits as: Acquired or learned responses which are regularly manifested.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006184

nodes.label: Harm Reduction
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Harm Reduction as: The application of methods designed to reduce the risk of harm associated with certain behaviors without reduction in frequency of those behaviors. The risk-associated behaviors include ongoing and active addictive behaviors.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D040261

nodes.label: Health Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Health Behavior as: Combination of HEALTH KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES, PRACTICE which underlie actions taken by individuals regarding their health.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D015438

nodes.label: Hoarding
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Hoarding as: A persistent difficulty discarding or parting with possessions.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D060845

nodes.label: Human-Animal Interaction
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Human-Animal Interaction as: Encompasses any situation where there is interchange between human(s) and animal(s) at an individual or cultural level. These interactions are diverse and idiosyncratic, and may be fleeting or profound. (https://www.avma.org/KB/Policies/Pages/The-Human-Animal-Bond.aspx accessed 8/22/2019).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000081762

nodes.label: Illness Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Illness Behavior as: Coordinate set of non-specific behavioral responses to non-psychiatric illness. These may include loss of APPETITE or LIBIDO ; disinterest in ACTIVITIES OF DAILY LIVING ; or withdrawal from social interaction.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D055809

nodes.label: Imitative Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Imitative Behavior as: The mimicking of the behavior of one individual by another.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007100

nodes.label: Impulsive Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Impulsive Behavior as: An act performed without delay, reflection, voluntary direction or obvious control in response to a stimulus.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007175

nodes.label: Information Seeking Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Information Seeking Behavior as: How information is gathered in personal, academic or work environments and the resources used.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D057226

nodes.label: Inhibition, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Inhibition, Psychological as: The interference with or prevention of a behavioral or verbal response even though the stimulus for that response is present; in psychoanalysis the unconscious restraining of an instinctual process.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007266

nodes.label: Marijuana Use
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Marijuana Use as: Medicinal or recreational utilization of MARIJUANA .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000074609

nodes.label: Motor Activity
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Motor Activity as: Body movements of a human or an animal as a behavioral phenomenon.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D009043

nodes.label: Multitasking Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Multitasking Behavior as: Simultaneous task performance, or switching between tasks in a concentrated period of time.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000073456

nodes.label: Personal Satisfaction
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Personal Satisfaction as: The individual's experience of a sense of fulfillment of a need or want and the quality or state of being satisfied.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010549

nodes.label: Recreational Drug Use
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Recreational Drug Use as: Occasional or habitual non-prescribed, not health-related use of substances.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000084783

nodes.label: Reproductive Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Reproductive Behavior as: Human behavior or decision related to REPRODUCTION .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D043762

nodes.label: Risk Reduction Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Risk Reduction Behavior as: Reduction of high-risk choices and adoption of low-risk quantity and frequency alternatives.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D040242

nodes.label: Risk-Taking
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Risk-Taking as: Undertaking a task involving a challenge for achievement or a desirable goal in which there is a lack of certainty or a fear of failure. It may also include the exhibiting of certain behaviors whose outcomes may present a risk to the individual or to those associated with him or her.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012309

nodes.label: Sedentary Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sedentary Behavior as: Behaviors during waking hours that have low energy expenditure and are often performed in a sitting or reclining POSTURE .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D057185

nodes.label: Self Stimulation
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Self Stimulation as: The act or process of inducing or increasing the level of arousal in oneself. It can be observed in various situations; for example, infants who are understimulated may explore their surroundings or babble to themselves.(https://dictionary.apa.org/self-stimulation accessed 12/30/2020)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012653

nodes.label: Sexual Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sexual Behavior as: Sexual activities of humans.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012725

nodes.label: Smoking
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Smoking as: Willful or deliberate act of inhaling and exhaling SMOKE from burning substances or agents held by hand.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012907

nodes.label: Social Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Social Behavior as: Any behavior caused by or affecting another individual or group usually of the same species.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012919

nodes.label: Spatial Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Spatial Behavior as: Reactions of an individual or groups of individuals with relation to the immediate surrounding area including the animate or inanimate objects within that area.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013037

nodes.label: Stereotyped Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Stereotyped Behavior as: Relatively invariant mode of behavior elicited or determined by a particular situation; may be verbal, postural, or expressive.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013239

nodes.label: Sucking Behavior
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sucking Behavior as: Any suction exerted by the mouth; response of the mammalian infant to draw milk from the breast. Includes sucking on inanimate objects. Not to be used for thumb sucking, which is indexed under fingersucking.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013391

nodes.label: Tobacco Use
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Tobacco Use as: Use of TOBACCO (Nicotiana tabacum L) and TOBACCO PRODUCTS .

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D064424

nodes.label: Toilet Training
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Toilet Training as: Conditioning to defecate and urinate in culturally acceptable places.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D014039

nodes.label: Acting Out
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Acting Out as: Expressing unconscious emotional conflicts or feelings, often of hostility or love, through overt behavior.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000184

nodes.label: Denial, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Denial, Psychological as: Refusal to admit the truth or reality of a situation or experience.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D003717

nodes.label: Displacement, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Displacement, Psychological as: The process by which an emotional or behavioral response that is appropriate for one situation appears in another situation for which it is inappropriate.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D004208

nodes.label: Fantasy
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Fantasy as: An imagined sequence of events or mental images, e.g., daydreams.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D005201

nodes.label: Helplessness, Learned
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Helplessness, Learned as: Learned expectation that one's responses are independent of reward and, hence, do not predict or control the occurrence of rewards. Learned helplessness derives from a history, experimentally induced or naturally occurring, of having received punishment/aversive stimulation regardless of responses made. Such circumstances result in an impaired ability to learn. Used for human or animal populations. (APA, Thesaurus of Psychological Index Terms, 1994)

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D006380

nodes.label: Identification, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Identification, Psychological as: A process by which an individual unconsciously endeavors to pattern himself after another. This process is also important in the development of the personality, particularly the superego or conscience, which is modeled largely on the behavior of adult significant others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D007062

nodes.label: Information Avoidance
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Information Avoidance as: Choosing to not obtain knowledge even if having the information could be to one's benefit.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000087366

nodes.label: Perceptual Defense
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Perceptual Defense as: Selective perceiving such that the individual protects himself from becoming aware of something unpleasant or threatening, e.g., obscene words are not heard correctly, or violent acts are not seen accurately.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D010467

nodes.label: Procrastination
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Procrastination as: The deferment of actions or tasks to a later time, or to infinity.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D000075682

nodes.label: Projection
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Projection as: A defense mechanism, operating unconsciously, whereby that which is emotionally unacceptable in the self is rejected and attributed (projected) to others.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011385

nodes.label: Rationalization
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Rationalization as: A defense mechanism operating unconsciously, in which the individual attempts to justify or make consciously tolerable, by plausible means, feelings, behavior, and motives that would otherwise be intolerable.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D011908

nodes.label: Regression, Psychology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Regression, Psychology as: A return to earlier, especially to infantile, patterns of thought or behavior, or stage of functioning, e.g., feelings of helplessness and dependency in a patient with a serious physical illness. (From APA, Thesaurus of Psychological Index Terms, 1994).

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012043

nodes.label: Repression, Psychology
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Repression, Psychology as: The active mental process of keeping out and ejecting, banishing from consciousness, ideas or impulses that are unacceptable to it.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D012094

nodes.label: Sublimation, Psychological
nodes.summary: NLM MeSH describes Sublimation, Psychological as: A defense mechanism through which unacceptable impulses and instinctive urges are diverted into personally and socially acceptable channels; e.g., aggression may be diverted through sports activities.

sources.title: NLM MeSH Browser descriptor D013359

nodes.label: Affect
